name: Bass Hunter
review:
A fishing game on a 3x5 grid with 10 paylines. Cash Fish carry values, Jackpot Fish hold bigger prizes, and Mystery Fish can be anything, while the Hunter Respin feature keeps the collecting going.

Medium volatility, 5,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.19%, lower than average, so factor that in if you're comparing fishing slots.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
